error.remediation: Tally took longer to answer one request of its Bills Receivable or Payable report at this date than ComplyEaze Bridge waits (20 seconds), so no figures were returned. On the one large book measured, that report's time grew with the bills open at the date: with about 15,000 open bills it answered, and with about 22,500 and about 29,900 it did not. Tally can go on building the report after ComplyEaze Bridge stops waiting, and on that book a read sent straight after was refused for time as well. Do not repeat the same call, and do not send another read of this company straight away: tell the user, wait, then call `tally_status` once, and go on only when it answers. On that book an earlier `as_of`, with fewer bills open, answered; whether one does here depends on how many bills were open then, and choosing it is the user's call.
